hooks.command: root=$(git -c core.fsmonitor=false worktree list --porcelain | sed -n '1s/^worktree //p'); h=scripts/harness; harness_notify_git() { git --no-pager -C "$root" -c core.fsmonitor=false "$@"; }; test -n "$root" && test "$(harness_notify_git rev-parse --is-bare-repository)" = false && harness_notify_git cat-file -e "HEAD:$h/notify.sh" && harness_notify_git cat-file -e "HEAD:$h/check-docs.sh" && harness_notify_git diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --quiet HEAD -- "$h" && test -z "$(harness_notify_git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "$h")" && test -f "$root/$h/notify.sh" && exec /bin/bash "$root/$h/notify.sh" codex; printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"早期通知は動きませんでした（起動の前の確かめが成り立ちません）。作業は止めていません。"}}'
